#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

static const long long mod = 998244353;

vector<long long> fact, revFact;

static void preFact(int n) {
    fact.assign(n + 1, 1);
    revFact.assign(n + 1, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        fact[i + 1] = (fact[i] * (i + 1)) % mod;
    }
    revFact[n] = pow_mod(fact[n], mod - 2);
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        revFact[i] = (revFact[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % mod;
    }
}

long long cmb(int a, int b) {
    if (a < b) return 0;
    long long af = fact[a];
    long long bf = revFact[b];
    long long abf = revFact[a - b];
    return (af * ((bf * abf) % mod)) % mod;
}

long long pow_mod(long long base, long long exp) {
    long long result = 1;
    long long cur = base % mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * cur) % mod;
        cur = (cur * cur) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n; cin >> n;
    long long tmp; cin >> tmp;
    if (n <= tmp) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    int k = (int)tmp;
    preFact(400000);
    long long ans = 0;
    int si = 1;
    long long t = cmb(n, n - k);
    for (int i = n - k; i >= 1; i--) {
        long long term = (long long)si * cmb(n - k, i) % mod * pow_mod(i, n) % mod;
        ans = (ans + term) % mod;
        si *= -1;
    }
    ans = (ans * t) % mod;
    if (k != 0) ans = (ans * 2) % mod;
    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
